_note: Canonical, periodically-updated catalog of cloud LLM providers' free tiers, for the constellation of apps that consume it (aarso/Workbench today; others later). These are external facts that drift — each entry carries its own sourceUrl; always verify on the provider's site before relying on a number. This file does not assert these numbers as nooz's own (never present external numbers as ours). Refreshed by .github/scripts/ai_catalogue_sentry.py (see .github/workflows/ai-catalogue-sentry.yml), which flags staleness but never auto-overwrites a figure — a human (or a future agent, per that script's own docstring) verifies each change against sourceUrl. Primary upstream cross-reference: github.com/cheahjs/free-llm-api-resources. This file's content originates from aarso's app/src/main/assets/free_tiers.json (2026-06-21), consolidated here as the canonical copy per the constellation's 'apps consume from nooz' data-sharing model; aarso now fetches this file directly rather than hand-maintaining its own (see D16). 2026-07-12: a full verification pass re-checked every entry's sourceUrl (or, where the page itself withheld numbers or returned an access error, the best corroborating evidence available); groq/openrouter/cerebras/github_models figures reconfirmed or refined against their own docs, cohere/deepseek figures corrected to what those providers publish today, anthropic/openai sourceUrls updated to the pages their old URLs now redirect to, and one new entry (Cloudflare Workers AI) added with a primary-source-verified number. google_gemini/mistral/together/anthropic/openai's headline figures were left unchanged this pass — either the page no longer publishes a hard number (gemini defers to a live per-account dashboard) or the only fresh evidence available was secondary/conflicting, which does not clear this file's own bar for overwriting a figure.

providers.name: Google Gemini (AI Studio)
providers.summary: Free tier in Google AI Studio. Gemini 2.5 Flash ~1,500 req/day; 2.5 Pro ~50 req/day. No card. (2026-07-12: Google's own docs page no longer publishes these as fixed numbers — it now points to a live per-account dashboard in AI Studio — so this figure is carried over unconfirmed rather than replaced with a guess.)

providers.name: Groq
providers.summary: Fast inference free tier. llama-3.3-70b-versatile: 30 req/min, 1K req/day, 12K tokens/min, 100K tokens/day. No card. (reconfirmed 2026-07-12 against Groq's own docs)

providers.name: Cerebras
providers.summary: Free Trial tier: 5 req/min, 30K tokens/min, 1M tokens/hour, 1M tokens/day — across models like gpt-oss-120b, zai-glm-4.7, gemma-4-31b. No card. (2026-07-12: model lineup on the free tier has changed since this was last checked — no longer Llama 3.3 70B.)

providers.name: OpenRouter (free models)
providers.summary: 28+ free models. 20 req/min, 50 req/day (raised to 1,000/day permanently after a one-time $10+ top-up — reconfirmed 2026-07-12 as an account-lifetime, not one-time, boost).

providers.name: Mistral (Experiment tier)
providers.summary: Experiment tier ~1B tokens/month — generous, but requests may be used to train Mistral's models unless you opt out (evaluation only, not for production). Mistral no longer publishes an exact free-tier number on this page; check Admin Console → Limits for your account's live figure.

providers.name: GitHub Models
providers.summary: Free during preview; rate-limited per model tier, using your GitHub token. Low-tier models: 15 req/min, 150 req/day; high-tier models: 10 req/min, 50 req/day; embeddings: 15 req/min, 150 req/day (reconfirmed 2026-07-12).

providers.name: Cohere
providers.summary: Trial API key: 20 req/min on Chat, capped at ~1,000 API calls/month overall. No card. Production keys are paid. (corrected 2026-07-12 — previously listed as a flat ~100 req/day, which understated the real monthly-cap structure.)

providers.name: DeepSeek
providers.summary: One-time new-account grant of ~5M tokens (~$8.40 of usage), valid 30 days, no card. OpenAI-compatible endpoint. (corrected 2026-07-12 from ~10M — DeepSeek's own pricing page returned an access error to this pass's probe, so this figure is corroborated by several independent secondary sources rather than the primary page directly; re-verify against sourceUrl when it's reachable.)

providers.name: Together AI
providers.summary: Small trial credit to evaluate; OpenAI-compatible. (2026-07-12: secondary sources disagree on the exact amount — reports this pass ranged from $1 to $50, and one claims the original signup credit was retired mid-2025 — so this figure is left unchanged rather than replaced with an unreliable number; re-verify against sourceUrl / an actual signup.)

providers.name: Anthropic (Claude)
providers.summary: No ongoing free tier; new accounts get a small one-time evaluation credit. Paid usage tiers (Start/Build/Scale) carry monthly spend caps of $500/$1,000/$200,000 respectively rather than any free allowance. (sourceUrl updated 2026-07-12 — the old docs.anthropic.com link now redirects here.)

providers.name: OpenAI
providers.summary: No meaningfully free tier: the account tier literally named "Free" is a spend-cap rung ($100/month max), not a grant of free tokens — a card is still required and usage is still billed. Limited free daily tokens have separately been offered via data-sharing opt-in in the past. (sourceUrl updated 2026-07-12 — the old platform.openai.com link now redirects here.)

providers.name: Cloudflare Workers AI
providers.summary: 10,000 Neurons/day at no charge, on both the Free and Paid Workers plans — usage above that is billed at $0.011/1,000 Neurons. Not a general OpenAI-compatible endpoint (Cloudflare's own REST API; some models expose an OpenAI-compatible route), so providerKind is left unmapped rather than guessed. Added 2026-07-12, verified against Cloudflare's own pricing docs.
